title: The Demon Path Saint's Request
next_chapter_hook: The runes on the ancient scroll fragment resonated eerily with the Tianji Record, and Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply at the familiar patterns—this was unmistakably a design he had seen in his father's study when he was young.

text.content:
The blood-red setting sun dyed the mountain forest a deep crimson. Chen Ji supported the tottering Ye Qing with one arm while clutching a blood-stained short sword in the other, the same blade that had just slain three Holy Sect pursuers. The wails of the dying pursuers had already faded into the depths of the forest, the air thick with a heavy scent of blood and the acrid smell of scorched earth. Ye Qing leaned against his shoulder, her pristine white garments soaked through with blood, her cold and beautiful face pale as paper, yet her hand still死死 gripped the blurred jade pendant hidden in her sleeve, refusing to let go.

Chen Ji gazed down at that jade pendant, his doubts growing like wild grass. What did this familiar scent of his sister—something that shouldn't exist here—actually mean?

dialogue.content: Where did this jade pendant come from?
dialogue.emotion: 压抑着激动，语调却出奇平静

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing struggled to curl her lips, a bitter smile escaping her pallid lips. She did not answer directly but instead drew the jade pendant from her sleeve, spreading it across her palm. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to look at it—though the patterns on the pendant were blurred, the jade itself was an extremely rare sheep's fat white jade, with faint remnants of the character 'Nian' visible at the edge.

"This... I found it in the depths of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds," her voice was weak yet clear. "It concerns a woman who had been imprisoned for many years and whose mind had nearly fallen into madness."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The remnant strokes of the character 'Nian,' a woman imprisoned for years—these details matched so closely with the circumstances of his missing sister Chen Nian. Ye Qing seemed to notice the intense emotional fluctuation flickering in his eyes but did not press further, merely continuing: "Chen Ji, I know whom you are searching for. That jade pendant may have a connection to the person you seek."

She raised her hand, her fingertips stained with blood tracing a blurred rune in the void: "But right now, we have more urgent matters to discuss."

Ye Qing's words fell like a boulder into a deep pool, stirring up layers of ripples. Chen Ji helped her sit down beside a blue stone, his gaze sweeping the surroundings—the pursuers had temporarily retreated, but the Holy Sect's search would never cease. He needed to make a decision quickly. Ye Qing's 'Demonic Path Mist' skill could conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, which was invaluable to him. Moreover, she seemed to hold clues regarding his sister.

But how much of the Demon Path Saint's words could be trusted? Could the blood feud between the righteous and demonic paths truly be erased by a mere alliance agreement?

choice.prompt: How do you respond to Ye Qing's alliance request?

choices.text: Treat each other with sincerity, exchange trump cards
choices.description: Reveal part of the Tianji Record's abilities to Ye Qing in exchange for the intelligence she possesses and subsequent cooperation, establishing a relatively equal alliance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust and more key intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May allow Ye Qing to gain leverage against you

dialogue.content: I can foresee events within the next three hours. The cost is the consumption of Heavenly Fate.

text.content: A flash of astonishment crossed Ye Qing's eyes, which then transformed into an understanding smile: "So that's how it is. A wielder of the Tianji Record... No wonder you've managed to hide your talents at the Tianqing Sect for so many years without being discovered." She paused, drawing from her bosom a scroll of yellowed ancient paper: "This is something I acquired unintentionally. Perhaps it will be useful to you."

choices.text: Keep trump cards hidden, each taking what they need
choices.description: Only engage in surface-level exchanges of interests, revealing no core information about the Tianji Record, maintaining room to withdraw at any time.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to gain Ye Qing's complete trust
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, reduce risk of betrayal
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may equally be holding back

dialogue.content: Cooperation is possible. But I need to know—why did you choose me?

text.content: Ye Qing gave him a deep look, seemingly sensing his wariness. She did not press the question, merely producing a black jade talisman from her sleeve: "This is the communication talisman of the Demon Path Holy Sect. If you change your mind, you can contact me through this. As for my sincerity—" she handed over a yellowed ancient scroll fragment: "This is something I acquired unintentionally. Perhaps it will be useful to you."

The moment Chen Ji took the ancient scroll fragment, he felt the copper coin at his chest quiver slightly. He calmly unrolled the fragment to examine it—the yellowed silk paper bore intricate formation rune patterns, with ancient characters inscribed at the center. The trajectory and arrangement of those characters bore a striking resemblance to records in his father Chen Xuan's personal notes.

Ye Qing, seemingly unaware of his reaction, continued: "This fragment originated from an ancient secret realm, said to have connections with all successive wielders of the Tianji Record. The Holy Sect has been investigating the Tianji Record's whereabouts for hundreds of years, and I..." she laughed self-deprecatingly: "am merely their chess piece."

dialogue.content: Do you know who the previous wielder of the Tianji Record was?

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart rate abruptly quickened. The previous wielder of the Tianji Record—that was precisely his father Chen Xuan. All these years, he had never stopped investigating the truth of his father's disappearance, yet had never found any clues. If Ye Qing could produce this scroll fragment, perhaps she truly knew something.

Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, seemingly considering her words: "As far as I know, the previous wielder of the Tianji Record was no extraordinary figure. He was merely an obscure wandering cultivator, yet one day he vanished without a trace. Some say he died in the depths of the Ancient Forbidden Land, others claim he was silenced by some massive force..." she raised her eyes to look at Chen Ji: "But regardless of the truth, the Tianji Record ultimately fell into your hands."

dialogue.content: Miss Ye Qing certainly has excellent sources of information.

Ye Qing shook her head: "Not excellent sources, but rather something I had to investigate thoroughly." A shadow flickered across her gaze: "The Holy Sect has been searching for the Tianji Record for hundreds of years. They regard all successive wielders as chess pieces. These prophets who can peer into Heavenly Secrets should be favored by the heavens, yet without exception, they all met their doom—do you think this is mere coincidence?"

Her question poured cold water over Chen Ji's heart. The shadow of the Heavenly Eye once again surfaced, and those possibilities he had been trying to avoid all along were now laid bare by Ye Qing's words. Could the tragedies of successive prophets truly be merely accidental?

choice.prompt: The information Ye Qing revealed strikes at Chen Ji's heart. How do you respond?

choices.text: Follow the current and deepen cooperation
choices.description: Since Ye Qing has already shown sufficient sincerity, we might as well advance the alliance further and lay the foundation for subsequent actions.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete intelligence network support

dialogue.content: Since Miss Ye Qing is so candid, I, Chen Ji, am not a stingy person either. If you ever need anything in the future, just say the word.

text.content: A strange light flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, seemingly surprised by his forthrightness. She nodded slightly, producing from her sleeve a small jade whistle: "This is a token of the Demon Path Holy Sect. With this, you can contact several hidden threads I have laid. If you encounter Holy Sect pursuers, it might prove useful."

choices.description: Accept the cooperation proposal on the surface, but secretly observe Ye Qing's true intentions, maintaining sufficient vigilance.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot obtain key intelligence in a timely manner
choices.visible_reward: Make a decision only after seeing through Ye Qing's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May miss the cooperation window period

dialogue.content: Miss Ye Qing's kindness, Chen Mou accepts. As for deeper cooperation... let's discuss it after both sides have shown sufficient sincerity.

text.content: Ye Qing seemed to have anticipated this, displaying no displeasure. She merely smiled gently, pushing both the ancient scroll fragment and jade whistle toward Chen Ji: "Then let this serve as our pact. If you wish to advance further in the future, you may contact me at any time." A playful glint flashed in her gaze: "I believe that day will not be far off."

Chen Ji tucked the ancient scroll fragment and jade whistle into his chest, his gaze falling on the blurred jade pendant. He did not ask about his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts—not from unwillingness, but from不敢. So many years of scheming and restraint had taught him to control his emotions at critical moments.

"This jade pendant..." he finally spoke.

Ye Qing seemed to understand his unspoken question, her voice soft: "I cannot currently determine that woman's whereabouts, but the place where she is imprisoned must be related to the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. With your current strength, rushing in recklessly would only mean death." She paused: "But with my cooperation, perhaps we could seize some opportunities."

Ye Qing seemed to sense the weight in his words, a complex smile appearing on her pale face. The setting sun had completely sunk behind the mountains, and night began to shroud this blood-soaked mountain forest. In the distance, the glow of torches and a hubbub of voices could be faintly heard—the Holy Sect's pursuers were regrouping.

"I should go now." Ye Qing struggled to stand, her form swaying: "Although the Demonic Path Mist can conceal your aura, it cannot last too long. For communication between us, use that jade whistle, but remember—" her gaze suddenly turned sharp: "Do not easily trust anyone. Including me."

As her words fell, her figure vanished like a specter into the night, leaving only a faint trace of ethereal fragrance. Chen Ji stood motionless on the spot, the ancient scroll fragment in his hand, his eyes flickering with uncertain light.
